{{Quote|An' check their weapons&mdash;''concussion-fired arrows''!|[[Kam Solusar]], on the Ysanna's concussion bows|<ref name="Dark Empire II 3">[[Dark Empire II 3|''Dark Empire II'' 3]]</ref>}}
A '''concussion bow''' was a type of [[Slugthrower/Legends|gun]] used by the [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]].

A concussion bow was a projectile weapon that used a small concussion charge to propel a small, arrow-like slug at a target. The stock of the weapon was rifle-shaped, and for all intents and purposes functioned as a rifle.

Ysanna could influence the trajectories of projectiles it fired with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="NoP" />
